lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the plan-approval gate write-side into the plan-runner pause-operator path

openQuestions: US-001's open question (PrdSnapshot has no top-level `title` field, buildPlanApprovalContext falls back to `description` then '(untitled PRD)') is still unresolved: US-003 (the sidecar production wiring, which builds the actual writePlanApprovalGateFn closure over writeGateAndNotify + buildPlanApprovalContext(prd)) should confirm this fallback order is what the operator-facing summary should show once the real prd.json (which currently carries `description`, no `title`) is read at the real call site.
nextStoryContext: US-002 wired the write-side SEAM only: `RunPostAuditOptions.writePlanApprovalGateFn?: () => void` is threaded through `runPostAuditAction` -> `handleAuditApproved`, called ONLY on the pause-operator branch (plan_approval='operator') immediately before returning `{ kind: 'awaiting-operator-approval' }`; the auto-mode proceed-branch path never calls it (verified in test/plan-runner-plan-approval.test.ts). The seam is deliberately a bare no-arg closure (NOT `(context: string) => void` like writeInProgressConflictGateFn, NOT writeGateAndNotify's own 4-arg signature) because plan-runner.ts does zero gate-construction work itself -- see the new patterns.md bullet for the reasoning. Doc comments on PostAuditActionResult/RunPostAuditOptions/runPostAuditAction were updated to state the pause now writes a resolvable gate, no longer a dead end. US-003 (not yet done) must: (1) build the production writePlanApprovalGateFn closure in sidecar.ts, capturing GATE_FILENAME path + { gate: PLAN_APPROVAL_GATE, options: PLAN_APPROVAL_OPTIONS, context: buildPlanApprovalContext(prd) } + makeSetPhaseFn + a real notifyFn, calling writeGateAndNotify(...) -- mirroring makeWriteInProgressConflictGateFn's factory shape in sidecar.ts (~line 2328); (2) wire that closure into the runPostAuditAction call site inside runPostPlanActions/makeProductionPlanPhaseFn; (3) register makePlanApprovalResolver (US-001) into makeProductionGatePhaseFn's GateResolutionRegistry, alongside 'in-progress-conflict', with a real proceedBranchFn (resume the paused audited PRD into the SAME branch-created git flow that executeGitProceedBranch already performs -- reuse it rather than re-implementing the git calls) and removePrdFn/notifyFn deps. exitPhaseAfterPlan already maps 'awaiting-operator-approval' -> 'awaiting-operator' and was intentionally left untouched this story (writeGateAndNotify's own setPhaseFn call already flips to the same phase, so the two writes are idempotent/consistent, not conflicting).
